title: News Analysis: Despite what Sean McVay says, definition of Rams' success hinges on Super Bowl title

sources.title: News Analysis: Despite what Sean McVay says, definition of Rams' success hinges on Super Bowl title
sources.description: Heading into training camp, Rams coach Sean McVay says a Super Bowl title won't necessarily determine if the season has been a success or failure.
